title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Movie Reawaken Man: The Red Set to Open in South Korea on September 30
content: The staff of Reawaken Man: The Red , live-action movie based on the webtoon Reawakened Man , revealed on Wednesday the film will premiere in South Korean theaters on September 30. Directed by Jong-yeol Baek, the film follows Hwan Seok, an ordinary job seeker who suddenly gains the ability to resurrect after dying.
author: ANN

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series White Scandal Confirms Main Cast
content: Entertainment company Ghost Studio announced on Tuesday that Kang Song and So-hyun Kim will reunite for the live-action series White Scandal , based on the webtoon/web novel of the same name.

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Official Trailer and Key Visual Revealed
content: The Ramparts of Ice ( Kori no Joheki ) Season 2 has revealed its first key visual and official trailer ahead of its October 1, 2026 premiere . The anime will stream weekly exclusively on Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Stays at #1, 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Rises to #5
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, stayed at #1 in its fifth weekend from August 21-23. The film sold 825,800 tickets and earned 1,241,646,800 yen (about US$7.80 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames Arc Reanimated Movie Now Streaming on Netflix Worldwide
content: Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames Arc reanimated anime movie is now officially streaming on Netflix worldwide. Studio BN Pictures handled the animation, with Naoya Ando as the director. The film premiered in Japan on February 13.
author: Anime Corner

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Katsuyuki Konishi
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Thursday that Katsuyuki Konishi will join the anime's cast as Hayden, the eldest sibling of the Benfield family. The anime will star Rikuya Yasuda as the protagonist Theo.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Remarried Empress Series Sets November 4 Debut, Reveals Teaser Trailer
content: Disney+ announced on Tuesday that its upcoming The Remarried Empress romance fantasy live-action series based on web novel and webtoon of the same name will premiere on November 4. The streaming service also released a teaser trailer and character posters for the series.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Wandance Film Reveals Dance Supervisors for Each Character, Musical Artists, Songs
content: The official website for the live-action film of Coffee 's Wandance manga revealed on Thursday the dance supervisors for each character, and the full list of music artists and song titles that will be used in the film.
author: ANN
